summary: Iteration 46 — Customer portal + new 6-category service booking feature. Backend: 22/23 pytest passed (created /app/backend/tests/test_customer_portal_e2e.py). All 6 new aircraft_type values (helicopter, chartered_plane, air_ambulance, yacht_cruiser, cargo, joy_ride) accept POST /api/bookings/inquiry and persist correctly (verified by GET .../status). Frontend: Full E2E booking submission with ALL 4 steps completed successfully twice (yacht_cruiser + helicopter). All 6 service cards render with images (naturalWidth=1264) and correct English labels+descriptions. Bookings navigate to /customer/inquiry/{id}. Customer portal audit of 13 subroutes: all pages load, no blank screens.

critical.issue: 500 AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get' at customer_routes.py:721 — `trip.get('accepted_quote', {}).get('amount')` crashes when accepted_quote is explicitly None (which is the default on new inquiries). Fix: `(trip.get('accepted_quote') or {}).get('amount')`. This breaks any customer stats/dashboard widget that consumes this endpoint.

Returns 500 for freshly created inquiries when opened via /customer/inquiry/{id} — fired twice (once per new booking) during E2E. Frontend InquiryStatus.js polls it. Should return 404 or empty list, not 500.

minor.issue: Returns 404 — frontend page (/customer/refunds) calls this non-existent path. The working endpoint is /api/customer/refunds. Update frontend or add alias.
Called from /customer/profile (or KYC) page → 403 Forbidden for customer role. Either customer UI should not call an admin endpoint, or a public/customer-scoped variant is needed.

Subject sent as literal `🚁 Your Helicopter Booking Inquiry #{inquiry_id} - AirYatra` — `{inquiry_id}` placeholder is not interpolated, AND subject hard-codes 'Helicopter' even for yacht_cruiser/cargo/air_ambulance/joy_ride inquiries. Confirmed in backend.err.log across all 6 test bookings.

ui_bugs.component: InquiryStatus.js — Aircraft field in Booking Details card
ui_bugs.issue: For yacht_cruiser inquiries, header shows 'Aircraft: ✈️ Plane' instead of 'Luxury Yacht / Cruiser'. Bottom Booking Summary correctly shows '🛥️ Luxury Yacht / Cruiser' but the top-level Aircraft label falls back to 'Plane' for any non-helicopter service. Also shows wrong ✈️ icon. Needs a mapping over all 6 aircraftTypes labels/icons.
Says 'View and manage your helicopter bookings' — outdated copy after adding 5 new service categories. Should be 'View and manage your bookings' or 'View and manage your flights/charters'.

The /services/helicopter.jpg used for Helicopter Charter card shows an airplane-in-city-skyline photo — visually the wrong subject (looks like a private jet). Users cannot easily distinguish helicopter vs jet card. Recommend replacing asset with an actual helicopter photo.

integration_issues.issue: 500 from /api/payments/transactions/{id} appears in browser console/network on every new inquiry open — see backend critical items.
GET /api/refunds/my-refunds → 404. Refund list still renders but network shows error.

critical_code_review_comments: customer_routes.py:721 — `trip.get('accepted_quote', {}).get(...)` is unsafe. The default-value form of dict.get is NOT used when the stored value is explicitly None (which is set at inquiry creation time in booking_routes.py:207). Use `(trip.get('accepted_quote') or {}).get(...)`. Grep the codebase for the same anti-pattern.
InquiryStatus.js — hard-codes 'Plane' as fallback aircraft label instead of consulting shared aircraftTypes; will regress every time a new service category is added.
MyTrips.js — subtitle 'helicopter bookings' hard-coded; will confuse users booking yacht/cargo/etc.
booking_routes.py — no validation that aircraft_type is one of the 6 allowed values; a client can post an arbitrary string and it will be persisted. Consider Pydantic Enum validation.
Email service — subject template literal `#{inquiry_id}` uses `{}` syntax but seems not to be `.format()`ed; also aircraft-agnostic subject line.

rca_of_the_issue: booking-stats 500: at customer_routes.py:721, `dict.get('accepted_quote', {})` returns None (not {}) because inquiries are stored with `accepted_quote: None` (see booking_routes.py:207). Chained `.get('amount')` then raises AttributeError. InquiryStatus 'Plane' bug: InquiryStatus.js has a hard-coded fallback rendering pipe that maps only 'helicopter' → 'Helicopter/🚁' and everything else → 'Plane/✈️'; needs to consume aircraftTypes[] to render label+icon by aircraft_type value. Email subject bug: template string uses `#{inquiry_id}` but Python .format only interpolates `{inquiry_id}` — the leading `#` outside braces is fine, but sending it literally suggests the subject was concatenated as raw literal, not formatted.
